snippet.title: [OUTDATED] SAGE 2025 Release Trailer – Project Reignition
snippet.description:
This demo contains all the stages from Sand Oasis to Skeleton Dome. It also features new skills, graphics, and music. A full list of features can be found on the Sage Booth:
https://sonicfangameshq.com/forums/showcase/project-reignition-sage-2025-demo.2540/
====================
This version is outdated. Catch the latest version here: https://youtu.be/NtDVY4pIm9Y


Trailer edited by:
Matt Kenney

Trailer Music:
- High and Broken - Sonic and the Secret Rings Original Soundtrack
- https://youtu.be/wL8O6UzvnaU
- https://youtu.be/cEGzFJMmoJU

Please let me know if the download link is down or broken.
====================
Project Reignition is a fan recreation of Sonic and the Secret Rings. Project Reignition is not affiliated with SEGA in any way. All rights go to their respective owners.
